Definition: from G4604; made of iron:--(of) iron.
BiblicalUsage: Sidereos means made of iron, and it describes the things that will not bend. The angel led Peter through the iron gate that opened of its own accord, the risen Christ promises the overcomer a rod of iron to rule the nations, and the locusts of the vision wear breastplates as it were of iron.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe iron in Scripture is the strength that breaks what will not bend, and the rod of iron belongs to the Son who will rule with it.
